etymologies.etymologyHTML: From month +‎ -ly (adverbial suffix).

definitions.definition: A publication that is published once a month.

quote.citation: 2009 January 5, Stephanie Clifford, “Prominent Magazines Lose Weight, Shedding Nearly Half Their Ads”, in New York Times‎[2]:
quote.text: Of the 10 monthlies with the worst declines in January, four were Condé Nast magazines: Wired, Architectural Digest, Vogue and Lucky.

quote.text: Katherine assumed she was having her monthly. She could recall times when her own monthly was so intense that it showed on her face.
